name: cms-monorepo
description: CMS 移动端配置项目 Monorepo

scripts.lint: turbo run lint && eslint scripts eslint.config.js lint-staged.config.js .prettierrc.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: turbo run lint:fix && eslint scripts eslint.config.js lint-staged.config.js .prettierrc.mjs --fix
scripts.ci:test: turbo run test --filter=!@cms/backend -- --run && pnpm --filter @cms/backend exec jest --runInBand
scripts.ci:quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm run ci:lint && pnpm run ci:typecheck && pnpm run ci:test && pnpm run ci:build
scripts.security:sast: pnpm dlx semgrep scan --config .semgrep/rules.yml --error --exclude node_modules --exclude dist .
scripts.security:scan: pnpm run security:audit && pnpm run security:secrets && pnpm run security:sast
scripts.ci:all: pnpm run ci:quality && pnpm run security:scan
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/agent/self-test.mjs && node packages/eslint-config/self-test.mjs && node --test scripts/agent/ui-governance.test.mjs
